title: campanula pusilla var. reflexa
intro: Campanula pusilla var. reflexa, commonly known as Dwarf Bellflower or Alpine Bellflower, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Campanulaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Campanula pusilla var. reflexa include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antiseptic and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
